description: Thoughts and happiness (F5c, ADR 066). A colonist's happiness is base plus the weights of its active thoughts, clamped to min..max; a thought lasts duration_days from the tick it was added.

at_or_below.description: The need value at or below which the thought is refreshed.

hungry.description: The need level at or below which the 'hungry' thought is refreshed every tick.

at_or_below.description: The need value at or below which the thought is refreshed.

slept_ground.description: The need level at or below which a colonist with no reachable bed refreshes 'slept_ground' every tick.

meal_items.description: Item kinds (items.json ids) whose eating adds 'ate_meal'; any other eaten food adds 'ate_raw'.

id.description: Stable thought id; saved in a colonist's 'thoughts' list.

weight.description: Happiness added while the thought is active (negative for a bad thought).

duration_days.description: Days the thought stays active after it is added (rounded to whole ticks, at least 1).

repeat.description: refresh: adding it again restarts its one instance; stack: each addition is a new instance, up to stack_limit (then the instance that expires first is restarted).

stack_limit.description: Most instances of the thought active at once (1 for refresh).

job_kinds.description: Job kinds whose toil-driven completion adds this thought to the colonist that held the job.
